recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work should be filed as targeted tickets for unresolved Procedure quantity, route, and supply use cases rather than changing the already-applied FHIR-33389 Observation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-33389 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 change request asking how to store device-related parameters when executing a procedure. The final OO decision moved the change from Procedure to Observation: add device settings, such as mechanical ventilator parameters, to Observation Scope and Usage and update Observation.device so it covers the device generating measurements or device settings.
initial_application: Git commit 63183dbbcb ("FHIR-33389") changed source/observation/observation-introduction.xml and source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml. The current source still contains the device settings bullet and the requested Observation.device short/definition text.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the checked Observation files are current build inputs. OO minutes on 2023-01-26 record the accepted disposition and clarify that the ticket moved from Procedure to Observation with text-only instructions for device settings. Related FHIR-37972 was later resolved No Change, saying device settings are supported as described in FHIR-33389 while broader quantity, route, and supply placement questions should be handled as targeted tickets. Direct Zulip search for FHIR-33389 found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source changes were made because the current Observation source already satisfies the published resolution. Adding Procedure or Device prose would exceed the accepted FHIR-33389 scope and duplicate or reopen topics reserved for later targeted issues.
